_documentation.model_purpose: 11th METAR Station: DXY (US Dollar Index) Global Sovereign Liquidity & Commodity Inflation Engine
_documentation.intermarket_mechanics: Surging DXY (+2σ) = Global Liquidity Squeeze + Commodity Deflation. Crushing DXY (-2σ) = EM Capital Inflow + Commodity Inflation (Oil/Gold Cost-Push).
_documentation.state_hierarchy: 150 Gaussian States (6 D1 Magnitude x 5 D2 Velocity x 5 D3 Volatility)
_documentation.signal_interpretation_policy: Strict Gaussian quantile edges derived from 14,008 historical DXY bars (1971-2026).
